relationships.subject: resveratrol
relationships.evidence_quote: After the intervention of RES, a TXNIP inhibitor, decreased FBG, increased BW, MPT and SNCV, and alleviated pathological changes of SN myelin sheath were observed in DM model animals.

key_findings: TXNIP, NLRP3, caspase-1 and IL-1beta protein were elevated in sciatic nerve of T2DM rats.
Resveratrol (TXNIP inhibitor) lowered these proteins and improved pain threshold, nerve conduction and myelin pathology.
